subject: Cat at the far end of a table, sniffing a vegetable; pepperoni pizza, fish plate and purple bottle in front
set: Indoor room, wooden table with food, white wall and framed window behind
notes: Table runs diagonally into depth. Food items sit in the foreground and midground, and the cat is small at the upper left. Red-white cloth in the lower left corner.

subject: Tabby cat walking toward a plate with a red fish
set: Indoor room with wooden table, chair, wall painting and water bottle
notes: Cat centred behind the fish plate. Low camera at table level, with the plate in the foreground and the purple bottle cut off at the left edge.

subject: Cat sniffing a cardboard box of trash with a fish, cans and fish bones
set: Outdoor alley with trash can, black garbage bags and grass
notes: Box in the foreground at lower right, cat at upper left with its head leaning toward the box. Bags hang over the box edge.

subject: Cat standing behind a plate of yellow paste or cream
set: Indoor dining room, wooden table, chairs and curtains
notes: Cat centred and facing the camera, plate in the foreground. Chairs frame the background and the table surface is blurred.

subject: Cat looking up beside a plate with a red fish flanked by fish-bone icons
set: Wooden table above a patterned rug
notes: Plate centred, cat at upper left looking toward the camera. Symmetrical fish-bone graphics on both sides of the plate. Strong motion blur in the table wood.

subject: Cat facing the camera with a thought bubble of vitamin icons (B12, K, C, D)
set: Outdoor grass field with trash can, logs and pole against a dark blue sky
notes: Cat centred and symmetrical, thought bubble above its head. Wide open grass in the foreground.

subject: Cat sniffing a fish on a plate, shown in black and white
set: Indoor room with table, water bottle and wall painting
notes: Same setup as shot 2 but desaturated, with a vignette. Cat leans over the plate in the centre.

subject: Cat looking down at a plate of raw meat and a green item, with another plate at the right
set: Wooden table with a rug below
notes: Cat cropped at the upper left. Meat plate in the lower left foreground and a second plate at the right edge, giving a diagonal composition.

subject: Cat standing on the floor facing the camera, with a burger and a green ball beside it
set: Indoor room with floral curtains, cardboard box, banana and wooden furniture
notes: Cat centred in the background. Wooden table edge in the foreground at the right and a burger at the left.
